lines.narration: Ten thousand birds. One sky. Zero air traffic control.
Starling murmurations twist like one creature — and they almost never hit each other.
Head-on collision course? Every bird plays the same two cards: veer right — and never at the same height.
No negotiation. No chatter. Just the rule. Every bird. Every time.
The real cheat code: each starling tracks about seven neighbors. Not the flock. Seven.
One bird turns — and the whole murmuration bends with it. One system. One move.
No towers. No radar. Seven friends and one rule.
Stuck in traffic? The birds solved it.
